notes.title: Used Cars Simulator - UPDATE #13 - Flipping junk cars and a CONTEST!
notes.notes:
🚗 Hey Awesome Drivers!

 
We have the next update ready! 

Here's what we did:
FLIPPING JUNK CARS

In various places on the map, you can find wrecked cars. They are heavily rusted, missing engines, and abandoned. You can take them over, restore them, and sell them.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/76c5c95fbcb8a9156c6466ff8c1f39fe30c1412a.jpg"]

TOW TRUCK UPGRADE - FIRST PART

We're adding the first part of the tow truck upgrade – the winch. You can use the hook and remote control to pull cars onto the tow truck if they're unable to drive (for example, if they don't have engines).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/37fa7780b9f4d42c9694ab1130b5ee3ccae92d69.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/56a69d2d01cb1c0bce637eba583462c27ab23a51.jpg"]

BODY SHOP

We're adding a new location - the Body Shop. There, you can remove rust from a wrecked car and install an engine.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/85b300aca221801596f71c78d67f72fd91ce7a34.jpg"]

NEW QUEST LINE

We're introducing a new set of quests for Season 1 – focused on finding and restoring wrecked cars. This gives you two alternative paths to choose from – legal and illegal. That means you no longer have to follow the car theft path (if you don't want to) to complete the next objectives. 



IMPORTANT! 

Even if you've already completed all of Season 1, this new path is still available through the Scrapyard Seller.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/81ec395c7a2413d47a135513262b99d433ccfc3e.jpg"]

NEW CAR MODEL

We're adding a brand new car model - MissleBishi Evil.

You can use it how you want - buy, sell, steal, destroy, repair, etc. You'll find it as one of the cars for sale.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/4f2e46a4d14cd1a042362e32b09ba71e4623615c.png"]

🚗 Hey Awesome Drivers!

It’s time for the next Weekly Update! As always, in a few points, we’re presenting to you what we've been working on this week in Used Cars Simulator 😀 Just a reminder – we’re showing what we're working on in the whole project. These are NOT the updates to the demo – it's the same as before 😀 

1. Toilets 

In Used Cars Simulator, you'll need to take care of your character's stats. One of these is the bladder level. Toilets will come in handy for meeting this need ;) We've placed them at various points on the map so you can easily find them in different locations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/cc3ee0ccd76cddebca7f5d7cdc3b83affe39a552.gif

2. Character Parameters - Notifications 

We’re adding notifications about your character's stats so you'll know when it’s time to head to the bathroom, grab something to eat, or get some sleep.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/30235c008319d1ab3e54ada71895637d7fa1e9a2.png

If you ignore these needs, there will be consequences. For example, if you don't go to bed and fall asleep somewhere on the street - you might get robbed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/619500f1f43e1fddf10bdeff4e85f273734c27ee.png

Or if you don’t make it to the toilet in time, you’ll wet your pants (this will increase your Criminality level).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/74ecdb00a6c73e80d9af9f04ebd5cb4cd65fd46d.png

3. Negotiations 

We’re improving the negotiation system. Sellers will offer you a price, but you can try to negotiate it. If you take the time to approach the car and carefully inspect the individual parts, you will have a better understanding of the car's condition - and this will allow you to lower the price.

We want the negotiations to feel realistic and keep them within fair limits. However, if you push too hard and repeatedly offer too low a price, the seller may get offended and refuse to talk to you anymore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/0024ebd2d34776080d8a9ae1d60d303eaa440ff1.gif

4. Prices 

We’re also improving a calculating prices system. The cost of a car will depend on its parts and their condition (the condition includes dents, dirt, and fresh paint coverage).

If you don’t have much money, you’ll only be able to afford a cheap car, which might be dirty or damaged. But you can always fix it later and earn more money! 😀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/66b7cc1899641565892190ddfbd264cf04996a2b.gif

5. Settings 

We’re adding more options to Settings and making sure you can adjust them freely. For example, if you set everything to Low, the other settings will automatically switch to Low as well. But if you want to customize specific settings differently, you’ll be able to change them easily, too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/ebca2fdbd7c9bd26d181e1b1028a03c1eebb64d3.gif

6. Optimization 

We’re still working on optimization - it’s a complex process. Our goal is to make sure the game isn’t too demanding on computers while also running smoothly. We’re testing various materials, terrains, and textures to see how they affect memory usage and FPS, and finding ways to improve performance wherever possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/1efa1a8faf2d383491b74b7a2b7789f6cc0cf7b5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/9d1b268045aa1e126f4948f7b19910917360ba41.gif

notes.notes:
🚗 Hey Awesome Drivers!

It’s time for the next Weekly Update! As usual, in a few points, we'll present to you what we've been working on this week in Used Cars Simulator 😀

1. Refueling the Car 

We are working on the fuel mechanics. Fuel will decrease while driving. You will receive two different notifications - that the fuel is running low and when it has completely run out. If you don't refuel in time, the car will stop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/bac580bd870c36b72fbbd3453bcc759b3cee6641.gif

When refueling, you will also see your money decrease (fuel costs, that's life ːsteamhappyː ).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/ffe4e8a72901454e2405b6c27041f46d343534df.gif

2. Exiting the Car 

We have spent a lot of time testing the car exit mechanics. We ensured that the player doesn't jump out or get stuck, for example, if you park too close to a wall. Here, you can see how we tested various options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/9682f0bcbab0956a8503a9183d66d3341a41406d.gif

3. Scrap 

We have been working on placing scrap in various locations on the map. It is one of the most valuable resources in the game - essential for repairing the car. You will be able to buy it at the scrapyard, but you can also find it yourself using a metal detector and a shovel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/2e24c093ee86aa21042a9e25072c04afaeb0adb9.gif

4. Underwater Visuals

The game will take place on an island, so there will be plenty of access to water. We wanted to ensure that the underwater view looks good too (in case someone wants to test if their car can function as a submarine ːsteamhappyː ).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/8be36c677c42a57a104dd6d0daecac2fa89af6c2.gif

5. Skills - Categories

We are working hard on the Skill Tree. We are introducing skill categories that will allow the player to decide in which direction they want to develop their character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/4005d2fc1a7d13be039f1cad2125c2d1441f0f4f.gif

6. 3D Car Plan

We have also started working on a 3D blueprint for car models. This will allow you to view different car parts more easily and check their condition. Each part will be properly highlighted. For now, we have begun creating the system for this blueprint - you can see how it looks in the initial stages.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/476078480d0cdda9285cfb3059716eed6fcb424b.gif

7. NPC - details

We are also continuously improving our NPCs. This week, we paid a lot of attention to details - like adding a red dress and improving hair (because previously, all men had receding hairlines ːsteamhappyː ).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748159/65971693302d2838292acb67a7f24394ec5c37fd.png

We have started working on the scrapyard. It will be a place where you can buy (or sell) scrap - one of the most valuable resources in our game. You will need it for fixing up cars.
